watchouts.what_to_do: Patch test if you have known plant/latex sensitivities.

benefits.mechanism: Aloe polysaccharides and sugars act as humectants, binding water at the skin surface for immediate hydration.
benefits.what_it_means: Adds lightweight, non-greasy hydration and a soft, comfortable feel.

benefits.concern: post-sun / heat discomfort / look of redness
benefits.mechanism: Its high water content and film-forming polysaccharides provide a cooling, comforting layer that eases the sensation of overheated skin.
benefits.what_it_means: Calms the feel of hot, tight or after-sun skin and the look of temporary redness.

evidence.summary: Humectant and skin-comfort role is an established cosmetic function of aloe gel; graded C (ingredient function).

overview: Aloe vera is a lightweight, water-based humectant that hydrates and comforts skin, especially after sun or heat exposure; a supportive soothing base rather than a treatment active.

ingredient.what_it_is: The gel fraction of the aloe leaf — a water-rich blend of polysaccharides, sugars and humectants used to hydrate and comfort skin.

marketing_vs_reality.reality: Aloe is a genuinely good lightweight hydrator and comfort agent, but it is a supportive base ingredient, not a treatment active — most of a formula’s active benefit comes from what is paired with it.
